response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Track), media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_unit_price, m.average_unit_price / NULLIF(b.average_unit_price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b ORDER BY CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
